steps.zh: 從新遊戲開始閱讀，依畫面提示推進對話，認識酒吧裡的角色與故事背景。
steps.en: Start a new game and follow the on-screen prompts to read the dialogue and meet the characters in the bar.

steps.zh: 遇到對話選項時，選擇你想說的回應，觀察角色反應與接下來的故事分支。
steps.en: When dialogue choices appear, choose your response and see how the characters and story react.

steps.zh: 想保留目前路線時先存檔，用不同存檔格記錄想再探索的段落，方便之後接續。
steps.en: Save your progress in separate slots to keep track of passages you want to revisit and continue later.

steps.zh: 想探索另一條路線時，讀取先前的存檔，再嘗試不同回應，回看故事與結局。
steps.en: Load an earlier save and try different responses to explore other story branches and endings.

steps.zh: 依初次開啟的設定選擇語言與外觀，再替小豬取名，進入豬舍開始日常陪伴。
steps.en: Choose your language and appearance during first-time setup, name your piglet, and enter its home to begin caring for it.

steps.zh: 在豬舍選擇餵食、散步或聊天，觀察小豬的狀態與反應，累積親密並培養個性。
steps.en: Choose feeding, walking, or chatting in the pig house, and watch your piglet’s condition and reactions as you build your bond and shape its personality.

steps.zh: 透過打工賺取金幣補充食物，持續照顧並留意成長進度，成熟後再決定是否結算。
steps.en: Earn coins through jobs to buy food, keep caring for your piglet, and decide when to finish the generation once it matures.

steps.zh: 結算後到收藏中查看解鎖的卡牌與故事，重讀已獲得的結局，再嘗試不同養成方式。
steps.en: After finishing a generation, view the cards and stories you unlocked in your collection, reread the endings, and try a different approach to raising your next piglet.
